_what: Act VIII -- the credits. The owner's design is issue #51, revised in session 2026-08-13. Every string here is the owner's or is read from vocab/casting.yaml and the GitHub API; nothing is composed at render time. Built by scripts/build_credits.py.

bed._what: PASS ONE -- the instrumental, on loop. Two spans in order, so the song starts on the drum smash, loops back to its own top, and never plays the breakdown. Owner: 'we want the song on loop basically but starting at the drum smash', and 'cut out the weird drum section with the moaning'. When this pass has played once IN FULL the bed hands over to `then` -- Nightwish's vocal Storytime recording. The instrumental pass and its measured spans remain unchanged.

segments._what: A -- the drum smash to the last full bar. 193.420 is the MEASURED re-entry after the breakdown, +12.98 dB, the largest onset in the song. The out point was 240.780; the owner cut it: ':46 - cut all of this part and go right to the drums so the entire song sounds like a loop'. The song's ENDING starts at 240.08 -- the level falls -11 -> -17 dB and keeps falling to digital silence at 241.95 -- and an ending is exactly what a loop must not contain. :46 on the credits clock is source 239.420; the cut is at 239.653152, the nearest beat in the bed's own tracked grid, 0.23 s later and still 0.43 s clear of the decay.

B -- the top of the song to the start of the breakdown, which is the part the loop exists to let people hear. 181.320 is where the level falls to about -13 dB and stays; ending here removes the 12.10 s 'moaning' section. The bed record's own committed excision found the same span independently (removed_sec 12.097596).

then._what: PASS TWO -- Storytime, WITH VOCALS. It takes over only after the instrumental loop has run in full; pass one is never shortened to make room. Storytime's quiet opening is skipped so the hand-over lands on the full-band entry rather than losing momentum. Its grid phase is unresolved, which is honest: this pass needs a beat-aligned entrance, not an invented bar line.

segments._what: MEASURED 2026-08-16 from Nightwish's official Storytime music video. The full-band vocal entry is a +6.23 dB re-entry at 14.880. 14.512472 is Storytime's own preceding tracked beat, chosen so the 0.25 s crossfade ends 0.118 s before the hit instead of shaving it. The recording sustains through 236 s and decays naturally to 244.134604 with no digital tail, so the credits end on the song's real ending.

reveal._what: THE REAL REVEAL, and the owner named its time: ':22 is when I want the comic book shot, put the cast after'. 22.080 rather than a flat 22.000 because a measured +5.01 dB onset sits there -- 0.080 s, under three frames, so the cut lands on a hit instead of mid-bar. The earlier anchor (the song's opening crescendo, 9.080 s into span B) is kept below: it is why the loop exists, and it is what to fall back to if `at_sec` is ever removed.
